items.title: JPMorgan maps Fed decision scenarios as Wall Street braces for surprise rate hike
items.summary: Investing.com -- Wall Street is hurtling toward one of the most unpredictable Federal Reserve rate decisions in years. With derivative markets pricing in a staggering 36 percent chance of a surprise rate increase, traders are bracing for a high-wire event that threatens to shatter the fragile summer market calm. While central bank decisions are usually well-choreographed affairs, Wednesday’s meeting presents an explosive, winner-take-all dynamic where billions of dollars hang in the balance. Mic

items.title: M&G (LSE:MNG) Stock Sees Modest Fair Value Lift As Analysts Fine Tune Targets
items.summary: M&G is back in focus after analysts nudged fair value estimates higher, with the central model move taking the figure from £3.09 to £3.19 per share. Recent research, including commentary from JPMorgan, has seen price targets cluster in a tight £2.95 to £3.35 range. This keeps the discussion firmly on fine tuning valuation rather than calling for a big rerating.
